idea-plugin.name: SigMap - AI Context Engine
idea-plugin.description:
SigMap — 96.8% Average Token Reduction for AI Coding Assistants

Zero-dependency AI context engine that extracts code signatures from 33 languages and generates compact context files for GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, and other AI assistants.

Features

  • Automatic Context Generation — Extracts function signatures, class definitions, and type information
  • Health Status Bar — Shows context health grade (A-F), token count, and age; click for the SigMap action menu
  • Toolbar Actions — Regenerate context, open context file, view roadmap with one click
  • Stale Context Alerts — Notifies when context is over 24 hours old
  • Settings — Tools → SigMap: explicit CLI path override, health-probe cadence
  • 33 Language Support — TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, Kotlin, Go, Rust, C++, C#, Ruby, PHP, Swift, Dart, Scala, SQL, GraphQL, Terraform, Protobuf, Vue, Svelte, HTML, CSS, YAML, TOML, Shell, Dockerfile, and more

Learn more at manojmallick.github.io/sigmap/
